test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What was the theme of the 10th Governing Council Meeting of NITI Aayog that was held on 24 May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Viksit Rajya for Viksit Bharat@2047**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Theme of the 10th Governing Council Meeting:** The theme of the meeting was "**Viksit Rajya for Viksit Bharat@2047**," which translates to "Developed States for a Developed India by 2047."
 
• **Objective:** The central focus of the meeting was to align state efforts with the national vision of transforming India into a developed nation by **2047**, marking the 100th year of India’s independence.
 
• **Collaboration:** The meeting emphasized strengthening the partnership between the central and state governments to achieve the goal of holistic development across all states in India.
 
• **Key Areas of Discussion:** The council discussed critical areas such as sustainable economic growth, equitable development, and innovative solutions to address challenges faced by states.
 
• **State Empowerment:** The theme reflected the importance of empowering states to take proactive roles in governance, development planning, and execution to meet the aspirational goals of **2047**.
 
• **National Vision:** The idea of "Viksit Rajya for Viksit Bharat" underscored the belief that the progress of individual states is intrinsically linked to the overall development of the nation.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Viksit Rajya for Viksit Bharat@2047.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About NITI Aayog:**

 
 
• **NITI Aayog** stands for **National Institution for Transforming India.** It was established in **2015**, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
• It serves as the apex public policy think tank of the Government of India, providing strategic and technical advice to the central and state governments.
 
• NITI Aayog focuses on fostering cooperative federalism by involving states in the decision-making process.
 
 
 
• **Vision @2047:**
 
 
• The year **2047** marks the centenary of India's independence, and the government envisions transforming the country into a **developed nation.**
 
• This includes achieving goals like sustainable development, equitable resource distribution, technological innovation, and improved quality of life for all citizens.
 
 
 
• **Role of States in Development:**
 
 
• States play a crucial role in implementing policies and schemes, as they are closer to the population and understand localized needs better.
 
• The theme emphasizes decentralization and empowering states to take charge of their development, in alignment with the national vision.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Governing Council Meetings:**

 
 
• The Governing Council of NITI Aayog is the primary platform for dialogue between the **central government** and **state governments**.
 
• These meetings aim to address developmental priorities and challenges faced by states, fostering a spirit of cooperative federalism.
 
 
 
• **Focus Areas of the 10th Meeting:**
 
 
• The meeting emphasized areas like **sustainable growth, social justice, innovation, and technology adoption** to achieve development goals.
 
• It also discussed strategies for better implementation of government schemes and policy frameworks at the state level.
